profile.headline: Principal Software Cloud Engineer  - Lead Frontend
profile.jobTitle: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Lead Frontend Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full stack web developer. I've been part of development teams for rapidly growing start ups where we built products from the ground up, as well as for more well-established companies with matured product-lines. 

I have experience in Swift/iOS Development, JavaScript, React.js, Redux, Node.js, API Development, MongoDB, SQL, Express, SAML, SSO, C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Bootstrap, jQuery, Firebase, HTML/CSS, SASS/LESS, Salesforce and Sharepoint and I am constantly learning more and more technologies. Additionally, I've acted as Scrum Master for multiple projects and am experienced in the Agile software development methodology. 

Previously, I worked in the oil and gas industry. Within four years at Kellogg Brown & Root, I rose through the ranks of the engineering giant as a non-engineer by starting as a temporary employee and rapidly ascending all the way to being hand selected by the company's Chief Intellectual Property Counsel to be part of his six-person task force in Houston despite my being a non-attorney.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer, Lead Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Led frontend platform work to increase adoption of an internal React + TypeScript component library used across multiple products and teams.

Led the component library’s transition to TypeScript-first APIs, establishing typed component interfaces and usage patterns that improved platform reliability and made adoption easier across product teams through better IDE support and fewer runtime errors.

Increased automated test coverage to 90%+ using Vitest with unit tests and snapshot tests, improving confidence for frequent releases.

Reduced time to correct defects from months to ~1 week by strengthening test discipline, tightening feedback loops, and improving platform reliability.

Cut feature request lead time from months to ~2 weeks by standardizing implementation patterns and enabling faster, repeatable delivery.

Successfully revived a broken live Storybook documentation site, restoring a reliable source of truth for components, usage patterns, and UI standards.

Driving development of a shared features library that composes the component library into reusable product-ready patterns to decrease delivery time for future initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · Tanstack · Storybook · Vitest

positions.title: Senior Software Developer Team Lead
positions.description: Full stack developer working on building out a revamped airline industry hotel and transportation web app. Team lead of 6 devs and 1 QA to build and deploy an entirely new module for a particular set of airlines that the company has never supported before. Architected database schemas and API and frontend layers to support the brand new, greenfield SaaS app.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · TypeScript · .NET Core · Azure DevOps · Git · C# · React.js

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Worked the full stack to support our debt management platform. I worked in Java, C#, MySQL with a focus in React. 

As part of a team, I developed critical portions in various brand new features rolled out to customers.
positions.insights: Skills: RabbitMQ · Node.js · Docker · Git · JavaScript · C# · React.js · Github

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Full Stack developer with a focus on mobile cross platform React Native and Swift/iOS development, C# backend API development, SSO and SAML integrations. I've worked as Scrum Master and Project Manager for multiple projects with a focus on Agile methodology while also contributing to the development of our multiple product lines.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · .NET Core · Swift (Programming Language) · Azure DevOps · Single Sign-On (SSO) · Git · SAML · C# · Project Management · React.js · React Native

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Full Stack developer using the an Node, Express, SQL, React stack while also being a primary contributor to business development.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Git · React.js · Github · SASS

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
A fully-immersive 12-week long boot camp dedicated to designing and building responsive web applications. 

Skills learned: JavaScript, jQuery, React, Node.js, Express, HTML5/CSS3, Bootstrap, Materialize, Vue.js, PHP, Laravel, Git, Handlebars.js, React.js, Angular2, Responsive Design, API/JSON/XML/JSONP, RESTful API, Firebase, MySQL, MongoDB, AJAX, State Management, Active Record and Command Line.

Topics Covered: Database Theory, API's, Agile Methodologies, Test-Driven Development and more.

positions.title: Senior Contract Specialist
positions.description:
I was recruited by and successfully integrated into the legal department as a non-attorney with no legal training. Despite lack of formal training or education in the legal space, the Chief IP Counsel of KBR recognized my tech skills and ability to adapt and transferred me directly into his team of five. 
During my tenure, these were some of my achievements:

- Successfully negotiated and executed over 140 non-disclosure agreements while maintaining over 400 non-disclosure agreements in various stages of negotiation in support of all business groups and technologies.

- Worked directly with dozens of clients and outside counsel representation to successfully execute non-disclosure agreements.

- Engaged with KBR’s corporate litigation in the organization and execution of action items associated with the defense of a lawsuit claim made against KBR.

- Actively assisted with the successful integration of an acquisition of 3 international businesses made by the technology business unit.

- Collaborated with mergers and acquisitions group to create alliance specific non-disclosure agreement templates.

- Successfully integrated Salesforce with the legal group to assist with daily tracking and maintaining of legal records.

- Continued support of negotiation and execution of commercial agreements for the technology business unit.

positions.title: Business Development, Technical Services
positions.description:
-	Responsible for the signing of fourteen new technical services agreements as well as generating approximately $4.7 million in job income associated with technical services across all different technology spaces in 2014.

-	Engaged with over forty active clients globally, providing them with customized solutions across the refining, petrochemical, coal monetization,  ammonia, equipment provision and automated solutions sectors.

-	Collaborated with marketing, management and technology leads to develop and establish new technical services product line offerings.

-	Worked with technology’s legal department to create two new technical services agreement templates – one to expand scope of services and products technology’s technical services line could provide and one shortened template designed to assist customers requiring emergency technical assistance.

positions.title: Sales Coordinator
positions.description:
-	Expedited internal alignment and resolution of complex deals requiring input from multiple business unit departments including but not limited to regional sales, business unit and corporate management, operations, international trade compliance organization, legal, tax, corporate business development oversight and treasury, all while maintaining an interface with customers.

-	Coordinated over one hundred transactions in the crude processing and ammonia producing technology spaces, providing proprietary equipment and services to clients in North America, India, Russia, Europe and Latin America with contract values ranging up to approximately $55 million.

-	Coordinated over ten key alliance and acquisition prospects, ranging from ensuring exclusive EPC alliances with worldwide leaders in specific technology arenas to adding new technologies to strategically round out the business unit’s portfolio.

-	Coordinated the implementation of a new protocol for all commercial document control within the business unit, streamlining commercial documentation processes to get proposals to customers more efficiently, all while maintaining best-in-class compliance with federal export policies.

-	Assisted with implementation of a single centralized archive for over three years of commercial documentation.

-	Developed the business case to business unit and corporate management to increase business unit oversight in small commercial transactions, thereby reducing burden on corporate resources.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: At the lab of Yan Xia, PhD., I conducted experiments involving mutagenesis by PCR, cloning, miniprep, purification, SDS gel preparation, transformation, Western Blot immunoprecipitation, and an immunofluorescence assay. The experiments and results recorded and presented in a written paper.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: At the lab of Weibin Zhou, PhD, I helped Dr. Zhou by genotyping zebrafish by isolating DNA, running PCRs on DNA, purifying or digesting said DNA, and imaging the DNA. I also phenotyped carrier zebrafish with microscopes.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I worked on project involving cloning a specific gene (mCCR5) into expression vectors under the supervision of Dr. Joseph Nthale and Alex Huang, Ph.D. I specifically performed experiments which included growing and maintaining cell lines, extensive use of enzymes, cloning DNA and cDNA, running PCRs, and gel imaging among other laboratory techniques.

company.name: Case Western Reserve University Wolstein Research Center
